tour.title: Project Overview & Architectural Conventions

tour.title: Declarative Theme Intent
tour.description: Inspect BasisIntent and control models representing user-provided brand colors, mood, fonts, and granular scalar overrides.

tour.title: Deterministic Theme Resolution Engine
tour.description: Follow the resolve() pipeline in ResolutionPipeline.kt, ResolutionContext.kt, and WorkingTheme.kt converting intent through priors, seed, derivation, control, and enforcement stages.

tour.title: Color Science: Oklch Conversion & Gamut Mapping
tour.description: Understand perceptual color calculations, Oklch transformations, and contrast repair algorithms enforcing accessible, vibrant palettes.

tour.title: Design Tokens & Foundations
tour.description: Examine immutable token wrappers like DpValue and the complete ResolvedTheme tree carrying color, motion, depth, radius, size, spacing, and typography tokens.

tour.title: Jetpack Compose Integration: BasisTheme & Ambients
tour.description: Inspect BasisTheme composable, LocalBasisTheme composition local, and ambient locals bridging resolved design tokens into idiomatic Jetpack Compose styling.

tour.title: Custom Lint Rules & Detekt Enforcement
tour.description: Explore Basis custom lint detectors ensuring proper font size usage (SpOnlyFontSizeDetector) and registry definitions.

tour.title: Pipeline Verification Test Suite
tour.description: Check the ResolvePipelineTest and unit test suites validating theme resolution, token conversions, and constraint assertions.

tour.title: Build Configuration & Convention Plugins
